name: ds-pricing-phase2
description: Phase 2: ds-reconcile balance reconciliation CLI + compaction-cost probe handler, reviewed via gates, then install.

run: test -f docs/phase-specs/phase-2.md && test -f docs/phase-specs/phase-1.md && test -f docs/research-notes.md && echo SPECS-OK

phases.task: Implement scripts/ds-reconcile.mjs exactly per docs/phase-specs/phase-2.md section 1 (read it fully) using the balance-API facts in docs/research-notes.md section 7. Zero-dep Node ESM. Requirements: reads key from ~/.pi/agent/auth.json (deepseek.key; never print it), GET /user/balance, appends balance.jsonl sample, prints balances + spend-since-previous + ledger-window sum + drift (handle empty/absent ledger gracefully), --once (default) / --daemon with --interval <min> (float allowed) / --stop / --help; daemon writes pidfile at ~/.pi/deepseek-pricing/ds-reconcile.pid, traps SIGTERM/SIGINT to remove it, refuses to start if a live pidfile exists. Also update install.sh so ds-reconcile is deployed to ~/.local/bin/ds-reconcile with chmod +x (keep the || true safety). Do NOT run the live API call (a later phase does).

run: node --check scripts/ds-reconcile.mjs && node scripts/ds-reconcile.mjs --help && bash -n install.sh && echo SYNTAX-OK

phases.task: Review scripts/ds-reconcile.mjs on disk against docs/phase-specs/phase-2.md and docs/research-notes.md section 7. Check: key read path and non-leakage, balance endpoint usage, top-up detection math (spend = prevTotal - currTotal + topUp), ledger window sum vs drift, pidfile lifecycle in daemon mode, graceful handling of empty ledger and API errors, zero deps. NOTE: if the live --once run failed due to network (its output may be empty), review statically and say so in the reason. Respond ONLY with JSON: {"verdict":"pass"|"block","reason":"..."}.

Add a guarded session_compact probe handler to index.ts per docs/phase-specs/phase-2.md section 2. It must: (1) on session_compact, if event.compactionEntry has a numeric usage with a cost object and a timestamp, recompute cost via computeCost for the deepseek model (entry provider/model fields), mutate event.compactionEntry.usage.cost in place; (2) then re-read ctx.sessionManager.getEntries() and locate the compaction entry; (3) append one evidence line to ~/.pi/deepseek-pricing/compaction-probe.jsonl: {ts, sessionId, model, recomputedTotal, objectTotalAfterMutation, reflectedInEntries: boolean|'not-found', note}; (4) everything in try/catch, never throw; (5) do NOT alter any existing handler or the ledger/report logic. Then run `node --check index.ts` and `node --test tests/` to confirm nothing regressed.

run: node --check index.ts && node --test tests/ 2>&1 | tail -8 && bash install.sh

phases.task: Review the session_compact probe handler in index.ts against docs/phase-specs/phase-2.md section 2. Check: existing handlers unchanged in behavior (message_end/tool_result/agent_settled/ds-cost), probe is fully guarded and cannot throw into pi, evidence line schema matches spec, mutation only touches deepseek compaction entries, tests still green. Respond ONLY with JSON: {"verdict":"pass"|"block","reason":"..."}.

run: node scripts/ds-reconcile.mjs --daemon --interval 0.05 >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 5; if [ ! -f ~/.pi/deepseek-pricing/ds-reconcile.pid ]; then echo DAEMON-FAIL-NO-PID; exit 1; fi; kill $(cat ~/.pi/deepseek-pricing/ds-reconcile.pid); sleep 2; if [ -f ~/.pi/deepseek-pricing/ds-reconcile.pid ]; then echo DAEMON-FAIL-PID-LEFT; exit 1; else echo DAEMON-OK; fi

phases.task: Phase 2 implementation is complete and deployed. Do NOT re-implement anything. 1) Verify on disk: scripts/ds-reconcile.mjs exists, ~/.local/bin/ds-reconcile exists and is executable, index.ts contains the probe handler, ~/.pi/deepseek-pricing/balance.jsonl has at least one sample line. 2) Update PROGRESS.md: mark Phase 2 Build/Review/Installed as [x]; leave Live verification [ ] and add a 'Phase 2 — LIVE VERIFICATION (PENDING)' section with exact manual steps: (a) user runs /reload, then /compact in a session and we inspect ~/.pi/deepseek-pricing/compaction-probe.jsonl to decide D-09 (mutate works or accept overestimate); (b) user runs `ds-reconcile` and checks the drift line; (c) optional: `ds-reconcile --daemon` long-run. 3) Append a phase-2 summary. 4) Commit with message 'phase 2: ds-reconcile + compaction probe'.
